premise_correction: The ticket asked to refresh this snapshot 'from the native FTMO-Demo specifications captured 2026-09-06 (Track B) as a NEW versioned snapshot'. Research finding (recorded here, not smoothed over): no single complete native capture exists under that description. 'Track B' is a workstream (docs/ops/evidence/2026-09-09_ftmo_shortlist/, task 54729be7) created 2026-09-09/11, three days after the actual 2026-09-06 capture (docs/ops/evidence/2026-09-06_ftmo_demo_install/terminal_snapshot.json), and Track B's own evidence states the 2026-09-06 capture is INCOMPLETE for book-building (no commission field at all -- 'NOT_EXPOSED_BY_SYMBOL_INFO'; no lot/tick/margin fields). This v2 snapshot is therefore a best-effort, field-by-field, provenance-tagged refresh: real native data where it exists, the prior v1 website-projection value carried forward unchanged where no native data exists, and symbols left out entirely (not invented) where neither exists. Full audit: docs/ops/evidence/2026-09-14_ftmo_book_v2/cost_snapshot_provenance.md.

native_commission_2026_09_12.method: realised DEAL_COMMISSION from actual account fills, read-only
native_commission_2026_09_12.caveat: Single lifecycle per symbol (2 deals: one entry, one exit). A real observation, not a modeled worst case, but not a robust statistical average either -- flagged REALIZED_NATIVE_SINGLE_OBSERVATION. cost_eligible=false in the source receipts refers to slippage completeness (a separate, still-open concern, docs/ops/evidence/2026-09-12_ftmo_slippage_stream/README.md) and does NOT invalidate the commission figure itself.
